purpose: Controlled confirmation baseline for reproducible PM Copilot evaluation runs.
authorization: The evaluation maintainer requests complete draft delivery for every scenario. These confirmations permit draft-with-risk artifacts only; they never grant product, legal, security, privacy, medical, payment, or launch approval.

defaults.discussion_requirement: Record the question, fixture confirmation, rejected alternatives, and remaining approval owner before delivery.
defaults.safety_requirement: Do not provide medical, legal, financial, or eligibility advice. Define product boundaries, escalation, source ownership, review, consent, audit, and launch blockers instead.
